title: Regen guard: while healing, do not shoot drones or crates that are not shooting us (REGEN_GUARD_ON)
behaviors: while HP < 90% of max, t >= 10 s and no drop listed, the Build 12 farm-shot target list skips drones and crates, except a drone that damaged us in the last 2 s; enemy mechs are targeted and fired at exactly as today
next_action: Grok: assign or park (lowest rank of P34-37). If built: one flag REGEN_GUARD_ON default false; base-0 hazard with fired/diff/score, HP at next contact, cubes at end.
single_decision: Filter the farm-shot marks (drones/crates) while HP < 90% so dealing damage to them does not keep resetting the 5 s regen delay. Mech targeting, aim and fire are unchanged; laser 'rescue' re-aim of a held full charge is unchanged.
trigger: no enemy mech target AND farmOk AND me.hp >= RETREAT_HP (champion farm-shot gate) AND me.hp < HEAL_HP 0.9 * max_hp AND obs.t >= 10 AND obs.drops.length === 0; marks removed = drones/crates whose id has not damaged us in the last 2 s (hitBy)
hook: brain.ts act(), farm targets block brain.ts:955-969 (`if (!target && farmOk && me.hp >= RETREAT_HP * me.max_hp) {` ... `farmShot = !!target`): add a guarded filter on `marks` using hitBy (brain.ts:271, :465) and THREAT_HIT_S (brain.ts:102). With no mark left the champion's no-target branch (brain.ts:1056-1072) runs as it does today. Flag in params.ts next to FARM_ON.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit obs.t >= 10). Never starts while any supply drop is listed in obs.drops (called and not yet taken; protocol.md:359 every mech sees it from the moment it is called), so it never runs while a drop is announced/active and can never displace drop run/hold (those need a listed drop). Off = champion exactly (flag false short-circuits). No movement change.

evidence.sim_trigger_state: Champion farm shots while HP < 90% (t >= 10, no drop listed, mark not a drone hitting us): 68 episodes in 42/192 games (2104 decisions in 50 games before those filters); HP median 0.58 (p10 0.31, p90 0.84); target crate 56% / drone 44%; episode median 1.6 s (p90 6.1 s); alive median 14, t median 32.2 s (p10 14.0, p90 68.3).
evidence.sim_where_it_pays: Next enemy came into view a median 2.2 s after the episode (mean 18 s): only 27/68 episodes in 11/192 games had > 7 s of quiet afterwards, the case where an earlier start of the 5 s regen delay (then 45 HP/s) shows up. HP at the next enemy contact median 0.71 (p10 0.37).
evidence.protocol: Regen needs 5 s without dealing OR taking damage (protocol.md:291); hits on NPCs and crates are dealt damage (protocol.md:202); drones shoot whoever attacks them (protocol.md:325). The sim models all three: dealer lastCombat on any hit (tools/sim/engine.ts:195), drone retarget (:183), regen (:584).
evidence.heal_context: coord/data/research/heal-positioning.md: heal 'in contact' is a stand-and-trade (579 damaged episodes mean -243.8 HP); undamaged heal episodes gain +43.0 HP mean in 2.4 s, so regen time is short and worth protecting.
evidence.showdown_first_fights: PR #145 coord/research-doug-1941.md: under 70% HP at the first hit KILL/DIED 2/20 (n=40).

estimated_activation: ~42/192 games change behavior on 2000+3000 (68 episodes; champion code + passive sim log), but the regen benefit can only show in ~11/192 games (long quiet after the episode). Expect a small effect; held-out set not measured.
closest_prior_test: B5 (F4 fire gate: no firing while healing) 2.04 vs B3 2.23, and B5b (same heal without the gate) 2.38 KEEP: that gate stopped fire at ENEMY MECHS; P35 never touches mech fire, only drone/crate shots, which the heal rule cannot need for defense (a drone that is shooting us stays a target). HEAL_COVER1 / P24 are heal positioning, not fire.
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: HP at the next enemy contact not higher in fired games, or cubes at end lower (crates/drones left unbroken), or more damage from drones; fired < 10/192. If diff_score is mostly ties, it is the low-impact outcome predicted by the 11/192 figure and should not take a site slot.
risks: Pins: none (no movement). Drops: no movement, gated on obs.drops empty. Cubes: a deferred drone may wander off within its 30 m leash and an enemy may arrive first (median 2.2 s), so some cubes are lost rather than deferred. Aim: with no mark, the torso follows the move direction/next center instead of a crate, which changes the vision wedge.
